ReportBuilder.title: Reports
ReportBuilder.body: Your own reports over your data: you pick a source, columns, filters and sorting, and save the whole as a report. A run appends its outcome with a row count to the history; the download is what the run produced. Schedules with delivery are a cloud feature and are labelled as such.
